row.title: A directive given to several sessions needs a claim and a collision gate
row.body: DATAGRAPH-1 reached several sessions at once; six PRs (2135, 2151, 2157, 2158, 2166, 2187) clashed on migration 0031, /api/graph and the datagraph command. collisions --prs now refuses the newer PR and collisions --claim is SOP step take.

title: A directive given to several sessions needs a claim and a collision gate
